a_systematics_template.fit_epochs: off-window only (outside every real window of either rung), deterministic uniform-in-time subsample of <= 150 epochs per (target, band)
a_systematics_template.fit_method: least squares with 3 iterations of 3-sigma clipping
a_systematics_template.model: f_model(t) = c0 + c1*dt_yr + cx*P_ra(t) + cy*P_dec(t) + cs*(seeing - median_seeing)
a_systematics_template.parallax_basis: P_ra, P_dec are the standard parallax factors computed from the astropy Earth barycentric position and the registry (ra, dec, parallax) - phase and shape fully fixed by astrometry; only the two linear couplings cx, cy are fitted (no free-phase sinusoid)
a_systematics_template.quality_gate: unit is searchable only if >= 30 off-window fit epochs survive clipping AND |median of control window statistics| <= 1; otherwise constraint-only
a_systematics_template.statistic_input: per-epoch forced flux minus f_model; window statistic construction unchanged

b_pseudo_window_exclusion.rationale: wide-beam signal leakage into narrow-rung controls inflates T - conservative direction only; rung verdicts on one target declared correlated in trials accounting
b_pseudo_window_exclusion.rule: pseudo-windows must avoid real windows of the SAME rung only (was: either rung)
b_pseudo_window_exclusion.undefined_disposition: units that still lack 8 valid offsets are constraint-only (S and completeness reported; no exceedance test, no candidate claims)

c_exceedance_rule.replaces: R = S/T > 1 (ratio unstable for T -> 0+ and sign-invalid for T <= 0)
c_exceedance_rule.rule: exceedance iff S > max(T, 0); report margin S - T

scope: channel A only; channel B constructions unchanged (validated clean on dev)
unchanged: controls count (8) and designated offsets/redraw sequence
